novelty_flags.label: thm:cost-optimal-certificate-feasible
novelty_flags.one_line: Its central comparison to AkbariEtesamiKiyavash2025Optimal gives no theorem, section, or page anchor in the statement-level gap; cite the exact ordinary formulation and set-cover results it delimits.

soundness_flags.label: def:operational-acceptance; thm:cost-optimal-certificate-feasible; prop:certificate-infeasibility
soundness_flags.one_line: Acc is called a total predicate on finite encodings and the optimizer is timed only in N_in, but positivity tests P_Reg(S)(H_slice)>0 and the source laws Reg are absent from X_phys and Acc's input signature, so feasibility/infeasibility is not an algorithmic predicate of the advertised input.

soundness_flags.label: ass:single-paid-action
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited JMLR paper assumes additive costs for arbitrary node-intervention sets; it does not state the physical restriction that every optional protocol has exactly one positive-cost action.

soundness_flags.label: ass:protocolwise-legality
soundness_flags.one_line: AkbariEtesamiKiyavash2025 does not state fresh-unit physical-protocol legality invariant across acquired protocols; this is a new translation-side restriction, not a standard cited condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:factorwise-no-synergy
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited weighted-set-cover construction concerns ordinary intervention collections and does not establish the proposed physical source-factor no-synergy condition under this name.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:uniform-source-normal-form and its downstream certificate/optimizer statements
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform exchange of source choice with free ancestral assignments is open and is required for the k-record normal form and canonical certificate bound.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The optimization, output-bound, and infeasibility claims are conditional on an affirmative uniform-source-normal-form theorem (or on an explicitly specified replacement witness interface).

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, Assumption 1; pp. 16–17, Section 4.1 and Lemma 11
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assigns additive costs to node-intervention sets and reduces its ordinary c-component design formulation to weighted minimum set cover after computing ordinary single intervention sets; it does not specify fresh-unit SELECT/RAND/READ protocol legality, one paid action per protocol, or physical slice no-synergy.

IDENTIFY+ is complete for a supplied source ctf-factor and CTFIDU+ is complete given a graph and a set of input distributions; the cited result does not select or price an endogenous source collection.
CTF-REALIZE takes an L3 distribution, graph, and permitted action set and returns an iid sample or FAIL; Theorem 3.5 gives realizability iff the algorithm returns a sample.

Theorem 1 gives the connected-c-component singleton reduction, Theorem 2 reduces weighted minimum vertex cover to min-cost intervention design, and Lemma 3 gives the hedge hitting-set characterization.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the acquired source-law/support information an explicit finite input or state a support-membership oracle model, then revise Acc, feasibility, and both runtimes to charge that representation or oracle access.

Retag the three one-action/no-synergy restrictions as novel restricted-subclass assumptions with physical justifications, rather than presenting the ordinary JMLR formulation as their standard source.

Add statement-level anchors for the ordinary comparator, especially JMLR Section 2's node-set cost model and Section 4.1's weighted-set-cover formulation, and state precisely which ordinary object is preserved by the embedding.

Resolve the uniform-source OEQ by either proving the quantifier exchange or providing a finite assignment-dependent switching witness and redesigning the certificate interface around the necessary parameter.

recommended_next_step: Revise the input model so positivity/source-law access is operationally defined, correct the three unsupported standard tags, and add the missing ordinary-design anchors before advancing this field-tier conditional kernel.
